content.title: Flower-Field Dance Escalation | Echo, Costume Shift, Petal Ring and Lift
content.summary: An adult festival choreographer escalates from solo dance to petal-ring levitation. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult performer remains identifiable. + Every escalation is triggered by continuing choreography. + The motion echo is temporary and never replaces the lead. + Wardrobe changes once while face and body stay fixed. + Exactly one levitation peak closes the sequence.
quick_start.recommended_input: One original adult festival choreographer begins a solo dance in a blue wildflower field. Push to the torso as her charcoal dress changes once into a cyan-coral festival coat. The same ring stretches upward and lifts her one body height for a readable full-body hold.

Every escalation is triggered by continuing choreography.
Wardrobe changes once while face and body stay fixed.
Exactly one levitation peak closes the sequence.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一成年舞者在花田持续舞动，分身、彩色换装、发光花环和龙卷依次提高视觉能量；身份与地理不变，最终升空作为单一峰值。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult performer remains identifiable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult performer remains identifiable."

invariants.rule: Every escalation is triggered by continuing choreography.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every escalation is triggered by continuing choreography."

invariants.rule: The motion echo is temporary and never replaces the lead.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The motion echo is temporary and never replaces the lead."

invariants.rule: Wardrobe changes once while face and body stay fixed.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Wardrobe changes once while face and body stay fixed."

invariants.rule: Exactly one levitation peak closes the sequence.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "Exactly one levitation peak closes the sequence."
